races.verdict: SEA OF DOUBT arrives on the back of a chase win and, reunited with a conditional who knows her well, is taken to follow up in a race lacking depth. Whispering Willow has posted 2 good efforts recently and rates the main danger, while Classy Cc and Victoria Kesia can also be involved if running up to their best. SEA OF DOUBT (IRE) WHISPERING WILLOW (IRE) CLASSY CC (IRE)

races.verdict: BROKEN ICE shaped well when runner-up at Perth 11 days ago and is taken to go one better.
